jsonl: UTF-8, one object per line; real newlines escaped in JSON strings

gold_envelope.id: aligned input id, including repeated delivery

reply_kind_semantics: Existing contract field: candidate/reference context kind, never the query target label. references[].kind has the same contextual role.
privacy: No needs kind/topic/gold or reply query target labels in inputs. Opaque independent identities, shared fictitious products across every class.
duplicates: Same id/source/author/text/created_at and all other fields; only received_at differs. Gold duplicate flag is delivery-specific.
ordinary_eligibility: eligibility means queue_standard only; a valid fix uses queue_fixed_notice with eligibility false.
fix_prerequisites: Same topic and product, verified independent sources, consent, approval, confirmed fix, human closure, approved notice and unseen query.
evaluation_caveat: Eight known singleton topics and sixteen unknown singletons per split. Topic-pair denominator excludes retransmissions; authors are counted by distinct author_id.
sealed: control inputs unavailable to candidate author until CONFIG-FREEZE; gold unavailable until predictions-only are written; authoring/adjudication are sealed too.
